title: Option+Space で Herdr をトグル

rules.description: Option+Space: Herdr が前面なら隠す、そうでなければ前面に出す

to.shell_command: osascript -e 'if application "Herdr" is running and frontmost of application "Herdr" then' -e 'tell application "System Events" to set visible of process "Herdr" to false' -e 'else' -e 'tell application "Herdr" to activate' -e 'end if'
